en.headline: Illuminated night parade lights up Causeway Bay as Arts in the Park continues
en.dek: The free carnival at Victoria Park runs through Sunday with interactive stalls, while police close several roads from 5.30pm for the evening procession featuring giant lantern puppets.
body: Arts in the Park 2026 continues today at Victoria Park in Causeway Bay, with free interactive art stalls and activities open from 10am to 5pm.

An illuminated night parade is scheduled for this evening, featuring five giant lantern puppets and carnival costumes along routes through the park and nearby streets. Police have implemented special traffic arrangements, closing sections of Kai Chiu Road, Yun Ping Road, Pak Sha Road and Lee Garden Road from about 5.30pm until late.

A day parade is planned for Sunday afternoon. Organisers describe the event as the largest in the series so far, with no advance booking required for the daytime activities. Members of the public are advised to use public transport and allow extra time around Causeway Bay.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣藝趣嘉年華今晚亮燈巡遊 維園免費活動持續
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園嘉年華有互動攤位，警方由傍晚約時半起封閉多條道路配合巨型花燈巡遊，周日另有日間巡遊。
body: 藝趣嘉年華2026今日在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園繼續舉行，免費互動藝術攤位及活動由上午10時至下午5時開放。
今晚將舉行亮燈巡遊，包括五個巨型花燈木偶及嘉年華服裝，沿公園及附近街道進行。警方已實施特別交通安排，由約下午5時半起封閉啟超道、恩平道、白沙道及利園山道部分路段至深夜。
周日下午另有日間巡遊。主辦方形容今屆規模為歷來最大，日間活動毋須預先報名。市民前往銅鑼灣時建議乘搭公共交通，並預留額外時間。
